test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, which of the following statement is true?

options.text: Most medicinal remedies contain at least one ingredient derived from a wild plant or animal
Wildlife habitat plays no role in preserving genetic diversity
Since prehistoric times, animals have been not been useful to us
Biodiversity is a measurement on the cultural ecosystems

solution:
The correct answer is **"Most medicinal remedies contain at least one ingredient derived from a wild plant or animal."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage mentions that **"virtually all medicinal remedies contain at least one ingredient derived from wild plants or animals".**
 
• This means that option 1 is true according to the passage.
 
• The word **"most"** in option 1 is incorrect, as the passage states** "virtually all".**
 
• The passage does not mention anything about wildlife habitat and genetic diversity.
 
• So, the statement **"Wildlife habitat plays no role in preserving genetic diversity"** is incorrect. 
 
• The statement "**Since prehistoric times, animals have been not been useful to us"** is incorrect, as the passage clearly states that animals have been useful to us since prehistoric times.
 
• The statement "**Biodiversity is a measurement on the cultural ecosystems"** is incorrect, as biodiversity is a measurement of the variety of life in an ecosystem, not cultural ecosystems.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
